title: Imports
subtitle: Bring an Excel / CSV register, a status tracker or minutes into the project safely. The file is kept as a source with its checksum, nothing in it is evaluated or opened, and a second person approves what is created. An import never changes an existing record: differences become proposals for review.

targetHints.risk: New rows become risks in the register; rows matching a risk become proposed changes.
targetHints.task: New rows become Draft, proposed tasks; a reported status stays a historical claim; tasks of the approved baseline get change requests.
targetHints.decision: Committee decisions are never changed: differences become change requests.
targetHints.source_claims: Each row becomes a claim in the source register, compared with the current record.
targetHints.document_claims: Text found in the document becomes unverified claims; nothing fills an official field.

honesty.title: What this pipeline does — and does not do
honesty.parser: Files are parsed in a separate process with memory and time limits, without file access or environment; an over-limit or malformed file is refused.
honesty.values: Values only: formulas are never evaluated (their cached value is flagged) and links are never opened.
honesty.scannerBuiltin: Malware scanning: Not configured — a built-in signature check only (files are never certified clean).
honesty.ocr: OCR and PDF text extraction: Not configured. Scanned documents and images are kept as sources; record their claims by hand.
honesty.osIsolation: Network isolation of the parser at operating-system level: Not configured (a deployment control).
honesty.approval: Nothing is created before a second person approves the preview, item by item.

detail.typeUnknown: Not established (held before the type check)
detail.noSource: None — the file was not kept as a source
detail.checking: The file is being checked in the isolated parser. This page updates by itself.
detail.failed: The file was refused by the safety check: {reason}. Nothing was imported; the service was not affected.
detail.quarantined: The file was quarantined for security review. It is never parsed, served or imported.

detail.awaitingApproval: Submitted — waiting for approval by a second person.

failures.too_many_columns: a sheet has too many columns
failures.too_many_cells: the file has too many cells
failures.cell_too_long: a cell holds too much text
failures.encoding: the CSV file is not UTF-8 text
failures.timeout: checking took longer than the time limit
failures.memory_limit: checking needed more memory than the limit
failures.file_missing: the kept file could not be read

mapping.title: Map columns to fields
mapping.description: Choose the sheet, the header row and which column feeds each field. A suggestion from the headers is preselected; nothing is imported at this step.

preview.title: Preview and comparison with the current records
preview.description: Each row shows what an approval would do. Rows matching an existing record show the current value next to the value in the file; the record itself is never updated.
preview.descriptionDocument: Each paragraph found in the document becomes an unverified claim for review. Nothing fills an official field.
preview.caption: Rows of the batch

actions.title: Next step
actions.submitC1: A second person reviews the preview and approves it row by row; you cannot approve your own upload.
actions.submitC2: If the records change before approval, the approver is asked to wait for a new validation.
actions.approveTitle: Approve and apply the accepted rows
actions.approveC2: New records are created as drafts or proposals; existing records are never updated — differences become claims or change requests.
actions.approveC3: Your approval is recorded with the batch and audited.
actions.rejectC1: Nothing is applied. The uploader is told the outcome; the file stays in the source register.
actions.rollbackC1: Records created by the batch are cancelled and its change requests withdrawn; its claims are removed. Codes are never reused and history is kept.
actions.rollbackC2: Refused when any of those records changed or is used since, or while the file is on legal hold.
actions.rollbackC3: Records the import did not create were never changed by it.
actions.cancelC1: Nothing is applied; the file stays in the source register.

outputs.title: Records produced by this import
outputs.description: Drafts, proposals, claims and change requests created when the batch was approved.

refusals.preview_stale: The records changed since this batch was submitted. The uploader must validate it again before it can be approved.
refusals.nothing_to_apply: No row of this batch can be applied (all are errors, duplicates or unchanged).
refusals.accept_not_applicable: Only rows with a planned action can be accepted; rows with errors or skipped rows cannot.
refusals.accept_none: Accept at least one row, or reject the batch.
refusals.rollback_not_feasible: Rollback is not feasible: some records changed or are used since the import.
refusals.rollback_legal_hold: The imported file is on legal hold; the batch cannot be rolled back until the hold is released.
refusals.not_uploader: Only the person who uploaded the file can map, submit or cancel this batch.
refusals.type_not_for_target: This file type cannot be imported into the chosen target.
refusals.macro_enabled: Files with macros are not accepted.
refusals.type_not_allowed: This file type is not accepted.
refusals.extension_mismatch: The file content does not match its extension.
refusals.above_clearance: The classification cannot exceed your clearance.
refusals.mapping_unknown_column: A mapped column is not in the header row.
refusals.mapping_column_twice: A column can feed one field only.
refusals.uploader_access_revoked: The uploader no longer has access to this project; the batch cannot be approved — reject it.
refusals.already_superseded: That source was already replaced by a newer one.
refusals.approver_lacks_authority: Your role cannot create the records this batch would create. Ask an approver who holds that authority, or reject the batch.
refusals.accept_duplicate_row: A row number is listed twice.
refusals.too_large: The file exceeds the upload size limit.
refusals.mapping_unknown_sheet: That sheet is not in the file.
refusals.mapping_unknown_field: A mapped field does not exist for this target.
refusals.mapping_not_applicable: Document imports have no column mapping.
refusals.invalid_transition: This step is not possible in the batch's current state. Reload the batch.

row.not_scale5: {field} must be a whole number from {min} to {max}
row.not_integer: {field} must be a whole number from {min} to {max}
row.bad_date: {field} is not a date (YYYY-MM-DD, DD/MM/YYYY or a spreadsheet date)
row.date_order: Planned finish is before planned start
row.target_incomplete: A claim about a record needs the record type, its code and the field
row.harmful_formula: {field} holds a blocked formula ({function}); formulas are never evaluated
row.formula_cached_value: {field} is a formula cell: its cached value is kept as untrusted text; the formula is never evaluated
row.formula_like_text: {field} starts like a formula; it is kept as text and never evaluated
row.internal_url: {field} refers to an internal address ({host}); refused, and links are never opened
row.url_inert: {field} contains a link; it is stored as inert text and never opened
row.duplicate_in_batch: Same {key} as row {row} of this file
row.unchanged: Already recorded as {code}; nothing to change
row.possible_duplicate: Possible duplicate of {code} (same title); not imported
row.create_risk: New risk; created in the RAID register when the import is approved
row.create_task: New task; created as a Draft, proposed task when the import is approved
row.update_proposed: {code} differs ({fields}); becomes a proposed change for review, never an update
row.governed_change_request: {code} is governed ({reason}); a change request is proposed and the record is not changed
row.decision_unknown: No decision {code} in this project; decisions are raised through the committee workflow, not by import
row.workstream_required: A new task needs a workstream
row.reported_status_claim: Reported status "{value}" is kept as a historical, unverified claim; it never changes the current status
row.claim: Becomes a claim in the source register for review; no record is changed
row.document_claim: Extracted text becomes an unverified claim for review; it never fills an official field

file.formula_cells: {count} formula cell(s): cached values only, never evaluated
file.external_links: {count} external workbook link(s) kept inert and never followed
file.data_connections: Data connections are ignored and never refreshed
file.hyperlinks: {count} hyperlink(s) kept inert and never opened
file.extraction_not_configured: No OCR or PDF text extractor is configured; nothing was extracted. Review the file and record claims by hand.
file.truncated_paragraphs: Only the first {count} paragraphs were extracted
